newsitem.title: MALTA: Radisson SAS Hotels in Malta franchise.
newsitem.headline: Radisson SAS Hotels in Malta franchise.

text.p: Radisson SAS Hotels on Monday signed a franchise accord with Island Hotels Group of Malta for the running of a five-star hotel due to open on May 1.

Kurt Ritter, president and chief executive of the Scandinavia-based chain, told a news conference on Monday they had for several years been looking for appropriate representation in Malta before teaming up with Island Hotels Group.

Winston Zahar, managing director of Island Hotels said the 252-room Bay Point hotel will be the jewel of his group, which also includes a complex of self-catering apartments and the four-star Coastline Hotel.
Point hotel is being built at the tip of St Georges Bay, four miles north of the capital Valletta and it will employ 600 people.
Radisson SAS Hotels Worldwide is a subsidiary of Scandinavian Airline Systems (SAS) and includes 80 hotels in 23 countries.
